text:
maria: Auditor Sam wants a tidy crosswalk showing how our RBAC consolidation impacted KMS access. They also want a signed evidence package (manifest + signature). Can we deliver by today? :eyes:

ajay: Which consolidation? The svc-* -> platform-service principal merge from 2026-02-10?

maria: Yes that one. Auditor listed four asks: 1) approver record, 2) exact policy diff, 3) a verifiable log slice proving only intended principals touched keys, 4) a signed manifest (SHA256 + KMS signature).

lee: I can pull a focused CloudTrail/KMS audit slice. Ill include KMS:Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/Sign and IAM role policy attach/assume events. Will export to S3.

nina: I found the approver in PR infra/iam#4123  approver @ajay, sec review @maria. I can attach PR diff + SEC-982 JIRA approval.

auditor-sam: Please normalize timestamps to UTC and provide a human-readable crosswalk: policy diff -> affected key ARNs -> principals added/removed. Also a short statement that no external principals gained access.

ajay: For signing: create manifest listing files+sha256, then sign with alias/audit-signing-key. Example flow:

# make manifest
jq -n '{files:["ct-20260210.json","pr-4123-diff.txt","policy-eval.txt"],generated_at:"2026-02-10T18:00:00Z"}' > manifest.json
sha256sum ct-20260210.json pr-4123-diff.txt policy-eval.txt > manifest.sha256
cat manifest.json manifest.sha256 > bundle/manifest+digests.txt
aws kms sign --key-id alias/audit-signing-key --message fileb://bundle/manifest+digests.txt --message-type RAW --signing-algorithm RSASSA_PKCS1_V1_5_SHA256 --query Signature --output text | base64 --decode > bundle/manifest.sig

lee: Query I'm running against our ES logs for GenerateDataKey between 2026-02-09 and 2026-02-11:
GET /logs/_search
{
  "query":{
    "bool":{
      "must":[{"term":{"eventName":"GenerateDataKey"}},{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"2026-02-09T00:00:00Z","lte":"2026-02-11T23:59:59Z"}}}]
    }
  }
}

maria: Tie this into INF-721 (CVE-2026-0123) triage: auditor asked whether any KMS keys were implicated in the exploit chain. We need a 2-line correlation statement for 2026-02-09 -> 02-11.

lee: Initial check: no anomalous GenerateDataKey patterns from runtime containers. Theres a scheduled spike 2026-02-10T03:12Z from svc-infer-batch (run-8812/run-8813), matched to job history. No ERROR responses from KMS. Ill attach container IDs and job IDs in the slice.

nina: For redaction, auditor says hostnames may be redacted but not principals/ARNs/timestamps/UUIDs. Will redact hostnames only.

security-bot: deploy-bot recorded export job export-20260210-ct-89 started by lee at 2026-02-10T19:04:12Z.

lee: Export complete: s3://redwood-auditor-exports/2026-02-10/ct-infer-kms-slice.json (12.4MB). Attached run IDs: run-8812, run-8813.

ajay: Manifest created and signed; manifest.sig uploaded next to bundle. Verification command for auditors:
aws kms verify --key-id alias/audit-signing-key --message fileb://bundle/manifest+digests.txt --signature fileb://bundle/manifest.sig --signing-algorithm RSASSA_PKCS1_V1_5_SHA256

maria: Assembling evidence-bundle-20260210.tar.gz (includes CT slice, PR diff, policy-eval, chain-of-custody.csv, README pointing to INF-721). Uploading to secure bucket and will provide presigned link with 7d TTL.

auditor-sam: Quick follow-up: please add a one-line chain-of-custody timeline (timestamp, filename, action, actor) and a brief explanation (2-3 sentences) of the policy-eval method showing no external principals.

nina: I'll produce chain-of-custody.csv with entries for export/sig/upload/approval. Will include the PR approval event.

ajay: I'll append policy-eval.txt describing we diffed previous/new key policies and ran our iam-policy-sim util to enumerate allowed principals; include sample commands and output.

lee: Also linking INF-721 in the bundle README so incident response artifacts are discoverable.

maria: Bundle updated with policy-eval.txt and chain-of-custody.csv. Final presigned link (7d TTL): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-auditor-exports/evidence-20260210.tar.gz?X-Amz-Expires=604800

auditor-sam: Verified signature. One last ask: can you paste the exact policy-diff snippet in the bundle showing the platform-service principal statements we added? That helps our control mapping.

maria: Added the PR diff file showing the allow statements for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/platform-service and removed explicit svc-infer-* entries. PR diff attached as pr-4123-diff.txt.

auditor-sam: Looks good, thanks for the fast turnaround. Closing this follow-up. :white_check_mark: If we need more evidence well re-open. Appreciated.
